book.magicka.guide:
G enables magic. Keys 1–4 and Q, E, R, F add up to five elements. Repeats are allowed; order does not matter — except for the eight ultimates, each with its own ritual order, shown in the book above the formula.

Left click casts Primary, right click casts Self. V clears the formula. K opens the 5x5x5 shape editor used by Stone Sculpture. H toggles instant cast mode (⚡ on the elements panel). In it most spells fire with no windup and constructions rise at once; streams (water and fire sprays, beams, four-element lightning) are channeled while the left button is held (≈), while bridges, stairs and growths start at once and finish on their own. Earth and root structures are permanent; ice and arcane fade. Committed casts cannot be changed or cancelled.

The book shows the signature spells you know. Elementals, ultimates, legendary and some of the strongest spells are sealed until you read their scroll: scrolls are found in chests, are never used up, and until then the formula casts the spell one element shorter. In creative everything is open. Use the tag tabs or search #building, #destruction, #summon, #support, #damage or #healing. Other combinations still work with manual input.

Drag a spell into a bottom slot, or select a spell and click a slot. Right-click clears a slot. Alt+1–4 fills a saved formula over one second, then you cast manually. Manual input or V interrupts filling. A preset never speaks the ritual, so ultimates cannot be fired from a slot. All bindings are configurable.

Page, selection, search, element and point filters, scroll and slots are saved between sessions.

Wet amplifies freezing and electricity. Self can harm you. Push into roots to climb them; sneak to slide down slowly. Ice Spike follows your view: up, straight or at an angle. Stone Stair starts at your feet; Skybridge starts at your aim. Aiming extends through loaded chunks.

Death (8) withers and drains life. Two or more Death summon undead servants that fight for you and fade after a while. They never attack their master, but stray arrows and blasts hurt both you and other servants, your own spells hurt them like any other creature, and a hurt servant may strike back. Raise Dead lifts recently fallen creatures; Soul Return and Resurrection (Life + Death) bring back fallen players.

Support spells (#support) light the way and help: Wisp Light (Life + Arcane×2) hangs a light where it lands, Lantern Trail (Fire + Life + Arcane) lights a path to the aim point, Glowstone (Fire + Earth + Life) places a glowing block. Cat's Eye, Gills, Fire Ward, Miner's Vigor, Revealing Flash and Douse give night vision, water breathing, fire resistance, haste, reveal enemies and put out fires. Lights and glowstone stay forever.

gear.magicka.wand.desc: Short formulas snap off instantly; long ones drag.
gear.magicka.staff.desc: Long formulas and zones; no quick trades.
gear.magicka.stone_gauntlet.desc: Earth, demolition and building up close; almost no range.
gear.magicka.arcane_orb.desc: Area and duration instead of raw damage.
gear.magicka.ritual_tome.desc: Heavy formulas read faster, light ones slower.
gear.magicka.ritual_focus.desc: Summoning and healing peak; direct combat suffers.
gear.magicka.heavy_expedition_coat.desc: Armour and weight: slower steps, slower casts.
gear.magicka.light_robe.desc: Fast casting and movement, less health.
gear.magicka.insulated_suit.desc: Your own lightning no longer charges you.
gear.magicka.frost_gear.desc: Your own cold is harmless; fire works worse.
gear.magicka.living_robe.desc: Constant regeneration paid for with fire frailty.
gear.magicka.conductor_ring.desc: Longer lightning chains; the charge settles on you too.
gear.magicka.ring_of_suspension.desc: The stone platform holds in mid-air without support.
gear.magicka.drowned_kings_ring.desc: The bubble lift becomes a water prison.
gear.magicka.frozen_heel.desc: Your own cold never bites you.
gear.magicka.glass_heart.desc: Huge damage on a much smaller health pool.
gear.magicka.stoneheart.desc: Stone shell on yourself also grants absorption.
gear.magicka.glacier_heart.desc: The ice step grows as a staircase, not a platform.
gear.magicka.rocket_charm.desc: The firebomb Self launches you up with a soft landing.
gear.magicka.conjurers_bell.desc: A bigger retinue, a weaker strike.
gear.magicka.storm_vessel.desc: Lightning and chains grow, casting slows.
gear.magicka.heart_of_the_mountain.desc: Earth tears out whole layers; you grow heavy.
gear.magicka.shepherds_bell.desc: Arcane and effect duration stretch out.
gear.magicka.mirror_prism.desc: The spell repeats at half strength a moment later, once every five seconds.
gear.magicka.second_tongue.desc: Every fourth element you speak doubles itself.
gear.magicka.blood_focus.desc: You heal others harder, paying in your own blood.
gear.magicka.grave_bell.desc: Your undead do not crumble when you fall.
gear.magicka.chaos_lens.desc: Four-element formulas hit harder and sometimes tear at you.
gear.magicka.soul_thread.desc: Life and healing instead of damage.
gear.magicka.brittle_charm.desc: Cold and demolition work as a pair.
gear.magicka.expedition_beacon.desc: Right-click drops a glowing marker where you look.
gear.magicka.rope_launcher.desc: Right-click throws you forward and up with a soft landing.
gear.magicka.camp_kit.desc: Right-click makes camp: a ring of light and regeneration for the party.
gear.magicka.reinforcement_tool.desc: Constructions grow larger and last longer.
gear.magicka.ingredient_case.desc: Effects last longer, casting is a touch faster.
gear.magicka.wand.bias: Faster at 1-2 elements, much slower at 4-5.
gear.magicka.staff.bias: Slower on short formulas, faster on long ones.
gear.magicka.ritual_tome.bias: Slower on short, faster on long formulas.
gear.magicka.ritual_focus.bias: Slower on everything but five-element rituals.
